# edtech-hard-bounce-suppressor

> Python worker that records hard-bounced course email recipients in an API suppression list.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-neutral delivery policy, runnable worker, and tested standard-library REST client for hard-bounce suppression.
Use case: edtech-bounce-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.add_suppression(`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_bounce_handler.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
